hypotheses.title: Standardized Unexpected Sales (SUS) Revenue Momentum
hypotheses.economic_rationale: While earnings per share can be smoothed via accounting adjustments, top-line revenue (actual_sales_value_quarter) provides an unmanipulated measure of corporate operational demand. Measuring quarterly revenue surprises relative to its 1-year trailing baseline, scaled by revenue standard deviation ((actual_sales_value_quarter - ts_mean(actual_sales_value_quarter, 252)) / (ts_std_dev(actual_sales_value_quarter, 252) + 1.0)), captures pure post-sales announcement drift (PSAD). Cross-sectional standardization via group_zscore produces a market-neutral signal with 100% universal instrument coverage and low turnover.
confounders: Unprofitable hyper-growth companies where surging top-line revenue masks deteriorating unit economics
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high revenue surprises do not predict subsequent positive excess returns within subindustries.

hypotheses.title: Sales-to-Price Revenue Valuation Multiple Mean-Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Equities experiencing severe price depreciation relative to their trailing quarterly revenue run-rate (actual_sales_value_quarter / close) exhibit cyclical price multiple compression. By evaluating the 180-day time-series rank of this revenue yield metric cross-sectionally within each subindustry (group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(actual_sales_value_quarter, 60) / close, 180), subindustry)), the model systematically captures valuation multiple expansions with 100% universal coverage in TOP3000 and low turnover.
confounders: Secularly declining industries where low valuation multiples reflect permanent technological obsolescence
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if compressed revenue multiples persist as value traps without mean-reverting.

hypotheses.title: Clean Parkinson-to-Implied Long-Tenor Option Volatility Premium
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Option market makers chronically inflate long-tenor call implied volatility (implied_volatility_call_720) to hedge tail risk and structural inventory constraints. In contrast, 120-day realized Parkinson volatility (parkinson_volatility_120) accurately captures physical high-low intraday equity volatility. The smoothed ratio of long-term implied volatility to Parkinson realized volatility isolates structural volatility risk premia with high information ratio, stripped of legacy polynomial and price delta boilerplate.
confounders: Impending catastrophic corporate litigation or patent cliff that justifies elevated long-term implied volatility
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if elevated 2-year call implied volatility accurately anticipates extreme equity regime transitions.
